meta.description: EduCo. is the parent company behind EduVerse, EduChat, EduRafiq, and EduAgent.
hero.title: One place to start. Four ways to keep going.
hero.sub: EduCo brings four focused learning tools behind one EduID. Sign in once, then choose the room that fits the question in front of you.
hero.note: A parent company, not another app to manage.
hero.indexNote: Choose a room for the question you have today.
about.title: Who we are
about.body: EduCo. is the umbrella. We build one identity (EduID) and four focused products so the Egyptian student finds everything in one place — curricula, AI help, Islamic guidance, and local power.
about.note: A single front door for a much bigger learning ecosystem.
ambition.title: Ambition
ambition.lead: We are building for scale without losing the human scale.
ambition.3: Islamic-only companion with full Quran/tafsir/seerah/sunnah grounding.
ambition.4: Local-first open-source harness for those who want control.
apps.title: Four apps. One EduID.
apps.sub: Different needs, one familiar key. Choose the path that fits the moment.
apps.verse.title: EduVerse
apps.verse.description: Everything the Egyptian student needs — Egyptian curricula only. Built to serve 1M users in the same second. Sponsors + paid courses will fund the ecosystem.
apps.chat.title: EduChat
apps.chat.description: Open-source models on an always-on external server. If your question is from your curriculum, it answers only from your attached books — PDF or text — never from weights.
apps.rafiq.title: EduRafiq
apps.rafiq.description: Your Islamic path companion. Same open models on a separate logical server, grounded only in Quran with tafsir, Seerah, and Sunnah. Outside religion? It redirects you to EduChat.
apps.agent.title: EduAgent
apps.agent.description: A local Harness you run on your device. BYOK — bring your own key. Open-source, yet secured by your EduID.
eduid.title: EduID in 3 steps
eduid.sub: Your identity travels with you across the ecosystem.
eduid.s2: 2. Confirm from the verification message sent to your account
footer.tagline: One identity. Four focused products. A clearer way forward.
